notes.title: Super Squash 4.1 - HUD Overhaul
notes.content:
(4.1.02 & 4.1.01 have been added to the update log)
Super Squash 4.1 has just dropped!
This update mostly includes several things that didn't quite make in time for 4.0. Let's get into it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/fc17f834a964a5da5673bd0f2794003c9c6e112a.png


HUD Overhaul:
One thing I've wanted to address for years now was the HUD which restricted itself to a 1920x1080 resolution. Fortunately that's no longer the case! All of the important elements will display right above your character. (They will only appear when certain stats change. For an example, picking up a coin or losing health.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/3ac7389a6209e38ee428181a3097f5231911ede5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/39d12ecf7b241c69c5454145c5b941f0afbb684f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/e16e47634106a2027f38a50393a1d853d3aa82a3.png

With this change several features have been implemented. Whenever the player's ultimate is ready, a notification will display on-screen and your character will flash yellow until you use it. The player will also flash red when low on health (even if you have your ultimate ready).



Barlock Games has a new logo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/1d58ede97632136d2dffe0faf50bcc131321600c.png

While it's definitely not an important addition, this new logo has replaced the older one when launching the game.


Update Log:

Added:

 NEW Overhauled HUD UI (ALL of the HUD elements will now display above the player, meaning MOST resolutions should be supported with Super Squash now!)
 New character indications (The player will either flash yellow when their ultimate is ready or red when they're low on health.)
 New Barlock Games logo when launching the game


Fixes: (4.1.01)

 Fixed the destructible structures from flashing red even when destroyed (Hell Wars world)
 Fixed the player from not continuously flashing when either their ultimate is ready or health is low
 Fixed some of the new HUD positioning (some elements would overlap the player)


Changes: (4.1.02)

 Changed specific HUD positioning (several elements were overlapping each other)


Until next time!

notes.title: Super Squash 4.0 + F2P NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Surprise! Super Squash 4.0 has just dropped!
Let's discuss what this update includes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/e53b1c46385607ef4c91451cd7169bbda47a7871.png

Visual Enhancements:
Upon re-visiting Super Squash, I noticed there were a lot of areas that seemed quite empty or stale. With this update I tried adding more variety whether it's extra details on the floors and walls or in some cases entirely new lighting; Super Squash has a new yet familiar style that'll hopefully be more pleasing to look at. Let's take a look at some examples:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/a0312ba80002e88374de6944b477ca644fe6c85a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/923b10c81e675a9b0ff96a3cfb3383dc2c490ef8.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/e25dd486267f19200542329182f147638aa12138.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/96eed56f957f824483bd313800bef63048490dc9.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/1bf5220080beb3f2c0b7d87d5096397420144a3e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/340d8e5f0bb216f496484352a58a1c3ab425a808.png
There are plenty of more changes throughout the designs though I felt like these were the most substantial differences.



Squash Mode:
Squash Mode is a challenging yet fun new take within Super Squash's already existing foundation. You start off as a random character and must complete 5 levels. All of which are also randomly selected. Upon each level completion, you'll be given a set of new challenges for the next level. Here are some examples: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/1a6bbf80555a5a7e0348747becb8a5da432094b6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/7ebd15475935f8637e9c9ca9243e0ad25fae1d9e.png

I won't spoil all of the challenges following the later levels but I wholeheartedly believe this is an incredible addition to Super Squash. I've also added an achievement upon successfully completing the mode!



Squash Museum:
This mode is exclusive to owners who paid for the game before it's free to play transition. Squash Museum is an insight on many cut areas and content that never found a place in the game along with some fun trivia! Here's a little glimpse of it:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/5f39404dc340de245b273be4d8c8054f019c19db.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/f46c243b7d8c37b445c231563ffa5adca8a87f8d.png



LOTS of Improvements:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/fcc41d7ad33b7b713ecf1546918a3224a31e6dbb.png
When play-testing Super Squash, my original intentions of re-visiting this game was to address the many bugs and issues that's surrounded the game for years now- and that's exactly what I've done. While there are some minor changes to be made, a majority of the game should feel pretty fluid. Let's go over the update notes:



Update Log:

Added:

Added Squash Mode (5 random levels and randomly selected characters. Each level progressively spawns specific enemy types and alters gameplay elements such as disabling lives, random traps, enraged enemies, lower HP, etc)
Added Squash Museum (FOR PAID PLAYERS) (Jump into never before seen areas and maps which didn't make the final cut of Super Squash)
Added 3 Achievements
Added various details throughout the game (extra background objects, extra colored walls/floors/objects so areas feel different from each other)
Added progression arrows throughout the game (this will help with less instructive areas)
Added footstep sounds (these are disabled by default but can be toggled in the settings)
Added a red glow effect to mission specific objects throughout the game (this will indicate said objects need to be destroyed)
Added new background of main menu
Added fading transitions to the main menu


Fixes:

Fixed the ending cutscene from resulting in a black screen after completion
of first level (Terror World)
Fixed an error from occurring when loading the third level of Terror World (through both menu's and cutscene)
Fixed being able to hear footsteps in the distance when loading the third level of Terror World (this also applies to quitting to the menu when on the same level)
Fixed the exit door from being deleted when locating all keys within the third level of Terror World
Fixed the level from changing the character to Butch when acquiring both throwing knives while on Blitz Mode (Hell Wars World)
Fixed Daiku World from soft-locking upon level completion (Both Free and Blitz modes)
Fixed the game from crashing when defeating the final boss (Daiku World)
Fixed the enemy spawn-rate of Hellentusks' second phase (Hectic Trouble World)
Fixed Nightmare Axe from dropping a white cube when being defeated (Hectic Trouble World)
Fixed cutscenes from playing while on Blitz Mode (Hell Wars, Hectic Trouble and Daiku Worlds)
Fixed fire effect from remaining once it's corresponding torch was destroyed (Hell Wars & Daiku Worlds)
Fixed Hectic Trouble & Daiku Worlds from initiating boss fights off-screen when loading specific levels
Fixed the Steel Tranquilizer enemies from permanently slowing the player down when attacked by them
Fixed Lava and Kor enemies from not dropping coins or progressing objective
counters when defeated
Fixed various fire effects from not emitting in darker areas
Fixed Kor Nests from des-pawning when in Blitz mode
Fixed Klank's firing effect (it is now no longer green)
Fixed explosion death of Lava enemies (they are now the appropriate color)
Fixed certain HUD elements from staying on-screen when quitting to the main menu


Changes:

Changed Blitz mode's random probabilities (levels across the entire game can now be a starting point rather than the first level of each world)
Changed Blitz mode's level completion (upon completing a level you'll immediately be taken to another random level with a random character)
Changed the HP of Wizard boss in Terror World (lowered by 50%)
Changed Dwenguil's model (it has been replaced with Malfunction II's)
Changed the scale and HP of specific enemies (this is so it's more distinctive which class they are)
Changed fire-rate of specific characters (Klank, LanternMan and Ashira all fire 50% faster. Mairoid's fire-rate was decreased)
Changed the destruction of torches. They should ALL now have the option to be destroyed
Changed both icon and loading screen


Enjoy the update and until next time, stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: Super Squash 4.0 + Free to Play
notes.content:
Super Squash is returning!
Including a 4.0 update and a Free to Play transition!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/f99564cb0f31738a96a1c5c9b0f1ed434a98610b.png
That's right! This update has been in-the-works for some time now and I can't wait for everyone to try it out.


Why Free to Play?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/e091e89c656da80ccbca6844e6484752265ad3c3.png
Super Squash is a fan-favorite under Barlock Games that I personally have always cherished and transitioning as a Free to Play title will allow more players to experience the all-out wackiness and fun adventures of this project.


What will existing owners be rewarded with?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/b401d0b4fd9d341ee36e84d4ce73c065c400cac4.png
Existing owners of Super Squash will have my utmost gratitude as well as a reward in-game that will be announced closer to the launch of 4.0.

Just make sure you have an existing save whether that may be stored locally or through Steam Cloud.


When will the Free to Play transition occur?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/f4eaa9548b5d5da1d6e567804ed46bcd82dc1509.png
Super Squash's Free to Play transition will take place once 4.0 launches. I currently do not have an ETA but expect it within the next several weeks.

That is currently all I have to discuss as of today but stay tuned for further announcements!

notes.title: Super Squash - 3.2
notes.content:
What's this? Another Super Squash update?! Yup! However this update mostly addresses several issues I've had on my backlog for a long while.

Fixes:

Fixed levels from not resetting when replaying them via Story Mode
Fixed Nightmare Axe from dropping a white sprite after defeated
Fixed Nightmare Axe from dropping the key in a different area after defeated

Changes:

Changed the Steam library image of Super Squash


That's all I've got for now! If you manage to run into anything be sure to let me know in the forums. Until next time!

notes.content:

notes.title: Super Squash 2.0 Available NOW
notes.content:
Super Squash 2.0 is available RIGHT NOW!

Let's discuss what this update introduces!


NEW characters: Ashira and Luthyuis

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/95eba9744a4e75dbdd5b912bdd2ad22dc4915011.png
These characters blast their way into the massive roster of Super Squash! Featuring unique appearances and abilities.


NEW world: Daiku

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/5fa6cbdb351614bd897529c3fe9b92f419186109.png
What was once a very habitable and happy place of life is now a deadly wasteland full of aliens. There will be PLENTY of enemies and objects that stand within your path. Do what you do best and squash them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/a7d4dba5fbeb8e9ae241fbdb4b3ef9a20f3b8069.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/df2ed7fa168303a24cf9bcb77f2166ee4a942084.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/63a1ff9a51c39899277e552e3090bdfedf3bca0a.png


NEW overhauled menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/38e427033940367d13c612c00686458a6da9f266.png
These new menu's will simply take you from point A to point B without causing confusion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/0d299e30fc2a158c9269afffb6248fb2b579eb50.png
Hidden trophies have also been added to every level of Super Squash! Good luck on finding them!


FULL Update Notes:

Additions:

Added an OVERHAULED menu (It is now much more easier to navigate and understand)
Added 1 NEW world! (This world contains a brand new environment as well as addition to the Super Squash story)
Added 5 NEW enemies!
Added 2 NEW playable characters!
Added 5 NEW achievements
Added collectible trophies throughout the entire game (You can find one trophy per level)
Added fog throughout Hell Wars World

Fixes:

Fixed the key from being invisble after defeating Nightmare Axe (Hectic Trouble World)



I hope you all enjoy the latest content update for Super Squash! Blast through those new enemies and have fun collecting all of the hidden trophies! Stay tuned for future updates.

notes.title: Super Squash Launch! + Future Content
notes.content:
Super Squash is available RIGHT NOW!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887838/f4eaa9548b5d5da1d6e567804ed46bcd82dc1509.png

Yep, that's right! Let's go over what is included with launch and what you can expect later on!


Features at Launch:

12 levels in total with 4 different worlds
6 playable characters
OVER 30 enemies and bosses combined
22 steam achievements
LOTS of customization (hats, player trails, etc)


Upcoming Features:

Additional levels & worlds
Additional playable characters
Minigames (which will feature the most random and addicting objectives)
Plenty more enemies and bosses to discover
More achievements to come
Additional customization choices for characters
Controller Support
Co-op Modes (These will mostly consist of several minigames)
And much more surprises on the way!


You can also grab the game right now for 10% off!


I hope you all enjoy Super Squash. Stay tuned for future updates coming REAL soon!
